name: Foreign Exchange Trade Instruction V 06
definition: Scope||The ForeignExchangeTradeInstruction message is sent by a participant to a central settlement system to notify the creation of the foreign exchange trade agreed by both trading parties.||Usage||The ForeignExchangeTradeInstruction message is sent from a participant to a central settlement system to advise of the creation of a foreign exchange trade.

TradeInformation.name: Trade Information
TradeInformation.definition: General information related to the trade.

TradingSideIdentification.name: Trading Side Identification
TradingSideIdentification.definition: Party(ies) on the trading side of the trade.

CounterpartySideIdentification.name: Counterparty Side Identification
CounterpartySideIdentification.definition: Party(ies) on the counterparty side of the trade.

AgreedRate.name: Agreed Rate
AgreedRate.definition: Exchange rate as agreed by the traders.

NonDeliverableForwardConditions.name: Non Deliverable Forward Conditions
NonDeliverableForwardConditions.definition: Specifies the conditions for a non deliverable opening or fixing confirmation.

TradingSideSettlementInstructions.name: Trading Side Settlement Instructions
TradingSideSettlementInstructions.definition: Settlement instructions for the amounts received by the trading side.

CounterpartySideSettlementInstructions.name: Counterparty Side Settlement Instructions
CounterpartySideSettlementInstructions.definition: Settlement instructions for the amounts received by the counterparty.

OptionalGeneralInformation.name: Optional General Information
OptionalGeneralInformation.definition: Specifies whether the trade is a block or an individual trade. It also contains supplementary information such as free format information, broker's identification, dealing branches and references.

RegulatoryReporting.name: Regulatory Reporting
RegulatoryReporting.definition: Information that is to be provided to trade repositories in the context of the regulatory standards around over-the-counter (OTC) derivatives, central counterparties and trade repositories.

PostTradeEvent.name: Post Trade Event
PostTradeEvent.definition: Information relating to post-trade lifecycle events.

SupplementaryData.name: Supplementary Data
SupplementaryData.definition: Additional information that cannot be captured in the structured elements and/or any other specific block.
